title: Emcee
description: Configuration for Emcee, the one bot — one instance, one token, feature modules toggle within it. Sections are tagged x-module ("emote" or "concierge") so the dashboard can group them into tabs; the module boundary is a UI grouping only, not a schema-level one — every field still lives in one flat, shared config object.

emote_on_say.title: Emote on say
emote_on_say.description: Someone types an emote's name in chat — no command needed — and their avatar performs it, even if they don't own it.

cooldown_s.title: Per-user cooldown (seconds)
cooldown_s.description: Minimum wait between one user's emote triggers.

disabled_emotes.title: Blocked emotes
disabled_emotes.description: These won't trigger just by saying their name in chat. "all <emote>" and "loop <emote>" can still use them directly — this only blocks the passive say-it trigger.

emote_all.title: Emote all
emote_all.description: "all <emote>" makes everyone in the room perform it as a staggered wave.

permission.title: Who can trigger it
permission.description: Who's allowed to start an all-room wave: just you, you plus anyone with Designer rights in this room, or a specific list of usernames.

allowlist.title: Allowed usernames
allowlist.description: Only used when "Who can trigger it" is set to specific usernames.

list_command.title: Emote list command
list_command.description: "emotes" whispers a paginated list of available emote names.

loop.title: Loop
loop.description: "loop <emote>" repeats that emote until the user says "stop" or leaves the room — the AFK-dance feature.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Off by default. This is the most demanding feature we offer — if you turn it on, keep an eye on things at first, especially in busy rooms.

interval_s.title: Repeat interval (seconds)
interval_s.description: How often the looped emote re-triggers.

max_concurrent_loopers.title: Max concurrent loopers
max_concurrent_loopers.description: Caps how many users can loop at once in this room.

max_duration_s.title: Max loop duration (seconds)
max_duration_s.description: Safety auto-stop in case someone forgets to say "stop" — for example if they close the app instead of properly leaving the room.

cooldown_s.title: Per-user start cooldown (seconds)
cooldown_s.description: Minimum wait between one user starting new loops.

welcome.title: Welcome messages
welcome.description: Whispered to a guest when they join — skipped entirely for VIPs, who get their own greeting instead.

templates.title: Greeting templates
templates.description: Use {username}, {room_name}. Rotates through the list on each greeting so the room doesn't feel canned.

cooldown_h.title: Re-greet cooldown (hours)
cooldown_h.description: Don't whisper the same person again until this many hours have passed since their last greeting.

busy_mode_enabled.title: Skip greetings when busy
busy_mode_enabled.description: Skip greetings entirely while joins are coming in faster than the threshold below, so a raid or event doesn't flood whispers.

quiet_hours_enabled.title: Enable quiet hours
quiet_hours_enabled.description: Skip greetings during a daily window (e.g. overnight).

vip.title: VIP recognition
vip.description: Named regulars get a distinct greeting instead of the generic welcome — always, even during busy mode or quiet hours.

template.title: VIP greeting template
template.default: Welcome back, {username} — always great to see you!

announce_to_room.title: Announce to room
announce_to_room.description: Also post a public chat line when a VIP joins, not just the whisper.

emote_celebration_enabled.title: Play an emote on VIP join

emote_celebration_id.title: Celebration emote
emote_celebration_id.description: Emote id from the Emote module's catalog.

farewell.title: Farewell
farewell.description: Logs when a regular (visits ≥ the threshold below) leaves. No whisper is possible — they're already gone — but an optional public send-off can post instead.

min_visits.title: Minimum visits to count as a regular

public_message.title: Post a public send-off
public_message.description: Off by default — a public message on every qualifying leave gets noisy fast.

filter.title: Word filter
filter.description: Custom terms trigger a private, whisper-only warning to whoever said them — never a public callout — and count toward the strike ladder below.

custom_terms.title: Blocked terms
custom_terms.description: Matching is normalized (case, common leetspeak, repeated-character squash) so simple obfuscation doesn't slip through.

anti_spam.title: Anti-spam
anti_spam.description: Catches message flooding and copy-pasted repeats. A trip counts toward the strike ladder below, same as a filter hit.

message_rate_count.title: Max messages
message_rate_count.description: More than this many messages from one person within the window below trips the anti-spam rule.

duplicate_count.title: Duplicate message threshold
duplicate_count.description: Sending the exact same message this many times in a row trips the rule.

ladder.title: Strike escalation
ladder.description: A filter hit, anti-spam trip, or !warn command adds a strike. Crossing a threshold below takes the matching action — only the highest rung reached fires, not every one below it.

strike_decay_h.title: Strike decay (hours)
strike_decay_h.description: A user's strike count resets after this many hours with no new strikes.

ban_enabled.title: Enable ban
ban_enabled.description: Off by default — the most severe rung on the ladder, kept opt-in.

ban_at_strikes.title: Ban at strikes
ban_at_strikes.description: Always requires at least 2 strikes, regardless of this setting.

exemptions.title: Exemptions
exemptions.description: Exempt users skip the filter and anti-spam entirely, and can issue mod commands in chat. The room owner is always exempt.

commands.title: Mod commands
commands.description: In-chat commands for exempt users: warn, mute, and kick a named user. Ban is dashboard-only, not available as a chat command.

position.title: Anchor spot
position.description: Two ways to set where the bot stands: say "anchor" in-game, or enter coordinates directly on this page. Either one updates the same saved spot — the bot walks back there on every reconnect instead of spawning wherever the room drops it.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns off both ways of setting the spot — the in-game "anchor" command and the coordinate fields below.

permission.title: Who can say "anchor" in-game
permission.description: Who's allowed to say "anchor" in the room and move the bot: just you, you plus anyone with Designer rights in this room, or a specific list of usernames. Only governs the in-game command — setting coordinates below is always you-only, since it's already behind your dashboard login.

allowlist.title: Allowed usernames
allowlist.description: Only used when the in-game anchor permission above is set to specific usernames.

idle_emote.title: Idle emote loop
idle_emote.description: The bot performs a low-key emote on a repeat interval whenever it isn't busy responding to something — a little life instead of standing frozen.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Off by default — a sustained background action, same caution as the Emote module's loop feature.

emote_id.title: Idle emote
emote_id.description: Emote id from the Emote module's catalog.

reaction_back.title: Reaction back
reaction_back.description: Someone reacts at the bot — the bot reacts back the same way.

cooldown_s.title: Per-user cooldown (seconds)
cooldown_s.description: Minimum wait between reacting back at the same person, so repeated reactions can't be used to spam the bot's actions.

default_outfit.title: Default outfit
default_outfit.description: A fixed outfit the bot wears on connect. Item ids must be owned by the bot (or free) — anything it doesn't own is skipped rather than rejecting the whole outfit.

item_ids.title: Item ids
item_ids.description: One Highrise item id per line, from the bot's own inventory.

outfit_presets.title: Named outfit presets
outfit_presets.description: "look <name>" switches the bot into a saved outfit.

allowlist.title: Allowed usernames
allowlist.description: Only used when "Who can switch looks" is set to specific usernames.

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: One per line, formatted as "name: item_id, item_id, ..." — e.g. "casual: shirt-basic-tee, pants-denim".

outfit_clone.title: Copy a look
outfit_clone.description: "copy <username>" makes the bot wear as much of that person's current outfit as it actually owns — items it doesn't own are skipped, never bought.

allowlist.title: Allowed usernames
allowlist.description: Only used when "Who can trigger it" is set to specific usernames.

min_match.title: Minimum matching items
min_match.description: If fewer than this many of the target's items are actually in the bot's own inventory, skip the copy entirely and say why, instead of applying a near-empty outfit.
